design_status: EXPLORATORY; windows and schemes designed after inspecting public reporting-drift CALENDAR_INCIDENCE.csv; 2023-2025 outcomes previously exposed
training_inputs: Each cutoff own frozen train time,event,groups and origin,stop metadata only; never later snapshots
person_time: [origin,min(stop,origin+24calendar months,cutoff)); actual days / (365.25/12); events at stop, included only stop<cutoff and stop<=24month cap; event on left window boundary included, right excluded
ratio: window events/person-months divided by historical events/person-months; both causes
support: fewer than5 distinct source event companies in recent window => slope1, including resamples; bootstrap repeats do not create independent event companies

parameter_bootstrap.implementation: resample whole spells, multiplicity weights for counts/person-time, distinct source companies for gate
parameter_bootstrap.interval: percentile2.5/97.5 of requested bounded gate-adjusted g; raw-ratio interval also saved; undefined raw ratios recorded

mapping: Fstar_k(t|x)=b_k F_k(t|x); c=0; slopes positive and time constant
certificate: terminal Minkowski envelope from merged96tree forest; if fails keep recovery fixed and reduce termination to greatest feasible slope; STOP if recovery alone infeasible or no feasible positive slope in [.5,4]; no clipping

arms.recovery_only: (1,g2_recovery); verify certificate; STOP if infeasible without changing fixed arm definition
arms.uncertified_2y: requested both2 slopes without certificate; diagnostic, NOT a legal model; squared-error scores labeled diagnostic, violations recorded

scenarios.high: largest annual rate in last5 complete calendar years divided by r_hist; same [.5,4] bound and certificate; annual support reported, no additional event gate beyond explicitly requested g1/g2 gate
scenarios.interpretation: not CI, no coverage guarantee; do not reorder scenario labels if unusual ordering occurs

evaluation.unsupported: 2025H24: predictions/legal checks only, all performance NA
evaluation.supported_metrics: same existing endpoint evaluator; assert complete supported horizons and IPCW weights1; otherwise STOP
evaluation.joint_brier: sum of cause-specific mean squared errors; excludes event-free state, explicitly labeled
evaluation.zero_observed: OE0; abslogOE +infinity; undefined/nonfinite bootstrap counts retained
evaluation.ranking: annual AUC/AP/Top20 and pair-weighted within-year AUC identical reference; pooled may differ; Top20 annualceil(.2n) tie sample_id ascending

bootstrap.indices: reuse cause-support saved indices, exact equality check
bootstrap.conditions: fixed forest, fixed slopes; excludes slope/training/selection uncertainty

validation.samples: all training and evaluation; all native times, both causes; explicit components and reload
validation.independent_person_time: pure Python per-company accumulation compared with vector implementation; cross-year,censor,no-event and cutoff-isolation tests

publication: aggregate only; small calendar event cells1-4 and identifying linked rates suppressed, exact private; no new ranking release
stopping: any gate, alignment, certificate feasibility or scope conflict: record and stop, do not modify rules
budget: 3 fixed cutoffs,5 fixed arms,3 scenarios;1000 train and1000 fixed-evaluation resamples;no fit/tuning; no automatic reference replacement
